name: Catalyst Canvas v1.8.0 — Prototype and Experiment Management
status: open-source strategic design and problem-framing workspace
layers: workspace-scoped Flask project registry and immutable revision storage
persona, stakeholder, journey, source, evidence, claim, and assumption studios
data-driven built-in and custom framework registry
divergent and convergent ideation sessions with idea lineage, clusters, merges, tags, votes, and rationale
transparent ICE, RICE, weighted-criteria, matrix, sensitivity, and decision-readiness models
prototype portfolio, hypotheses, participant plans, metrics, safeguards, experiment runs, learning decisions, and iteration history
Research Lab and Workbench experiment-handoff packages
Decision Studio and Workbench decision-handoff packages
Knowledge Library and Research Librarian research-handoff packages
Python, Flask, CLI, and WordPress browser adapters
stable JSON, Markdown, print-report, research-handoff, decision-handoff, experiment-handoff, and framework-package exporters
method_path: challenge -> research/evidence -> HMW -> framework prompts -> ideas -> prioritization/sensitivity -> decision readiness -> prototype -> experiment -> review/handoff
compatibility_note: python/catalyst_canvas_core.py and python/catalyst_canvas_brief.py are deprecated adapters over the catalyst_canvas package
storage_model: workspaces -> projects -> immutable Canvas Contract 1.5 revisions + reusable research, evidence, framework, ideation, prioritization, prototype, experiment, and handoff records
behavioral_signal_boundary: Analytics and GA4 CSV rows are evidence hints only and cannot create identity, intent, motivation, or demographic claims.
evidence_boundary: Ledger coverage indicators describe recorded links and gaps; they do not score truth or research quality.
ideation_boundary: Idea votes and selections represent participant judgment and do not establish objective quality or decision readiness.
prioritization_boundary: Scores and rankings expose inputs, basis, confidence, rationale, evidence, and weights; they do not replace judgment, ethical review, governance, or technical validation.
experiment_boundary: Experiment readiness reports workflow coverage and recorded learning. It does not establish causal validity, statistical power, safety, desirability, feasibility, viability, or impact.
